theorem backend.lastVal_cons (e : backend.Ent) (l : List backend.Ent) (k : GoString) :
    backend.lastVal (e :: l) k = (backend.lastVal l k).or (if e.fst = k then some e.snd else none)

theorem backend.dedupLast_ne {e f : backend.Ent} {rest : List backend.Ent} (h : ¬e.fst = f.fst) :
    backend.dedupLast (e :: f :: rest) = e :: backend.dedupLast (f :: rest)

theorem backend.entsSorted_nil : backend.entsSorted []

def backend.keyIs (k : GoString) : backend.Ent → Bool :=
  decide (e.fst = k)

    l) k = backend.lastVal l k

theorem backend.entLe_true {a b : backend.Ent} : backend.entLe a b = true ↔ ¬backend.strLt b.fst
    a.fst

theorem backend.dedupLast.eq_def (x✝ : List backend.Ent) : backend.dedupLast x✝ = match x✝ with | []
    => [] | [e] => [e] | e :: f :: rest => if e.fst = f.fst then backend.dedupLast (f :: rest) else
    e :: backend.dedupLast (f :: rest)

theorem backend.entsSorted_append {a b : List backend.Ent} : backend.entsSorted (a ++ b) ↔
    backend.entsSorted a ∧ backend.entsSorted b ∧ ∀ (x : backend.Ent), x ∈ a → ∀ (y : backend.Ent),
    y ∈ b → backend.strLt x.fst y.fst

    backend.dedupLast (e :: f :: rest) = backend.dedupLast (f :: rest)

    b.fst a.fst) (l.mergeSort backend.entLe)

    (e : backend.Ent), motive [e]) (case3 : ∀ (e f : backend.Ent) (rest : List backend.Ent), e.fst =
    f.fst → motive (f :: rest) → motive (e :: f :: rest)) (case4 : ∀ (e f : backend.Ent) (rest :

    backend.Ent) : motive a✝

theorem backend.entLe_total' (a b : backend.Ent) : (backend.entLe a b || backend.entLe b a) = true

theorem backend.bkOf_wbAdd (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (id id' : w64) (e : backend.Ent) :
    backend.bkOf (backend.wbAdd B id e) id' = if id = id' then backend.bkOf B id ++ [e] else
    backend.bkOf B id'

theorem backend.entLe_trans' (a b c : backend.Ent) (h1 : backend.entLe a b = true) (h2 :
    backend.entLe b c = true) : backend.entLe a c = true

theorem backend.lastVal_append (a b : List backend.Ent) (k : GoString) : backend.lastVal (a ++ b) k
    = (backend.lastVal b k).or (backend.lastVal a k)

theorem backend.canon_append_canon (a b : List backend.Ent) : backend.canon (a ++ backend.canon b) =
    backend.canon (a ++ b)
